blind.B1: No exercise question: C2C12 myotubes with Arrdc2/Arrdc3 adenoviral overexpression (abstract: 'Arrdc2 and Arrdc3 mRNAs were overexpressed in C2C12 myotubes'); in vitro, not even an exercise-mediator design. No sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: Arrdc2 (or Arrdc3) vs control adenovirus in myotubes; n not in abstract.
blind.B3: No repeated animals; packet A lists no candidate pairing keys; cell wells.
blind.B5: Abstract gives no DEG rule or counts.

checks.evidence: Refused: cell-culture overexpression, no exercise arm; matches abstract (C2C12 overexpression).
HANDBACK gives no paper-vs-ours number for this case

'No exercise contrast' is true (abstract). Secondary reason (matrix labels GFP3-7/Arrdc2-6,7,9,10,11 vs titles 1-5) is recorded as a discrepancy and would only matter if the series were wanted; the group is clear from prefix.

human_items: Whether in-vitro overexpression series count as exercise studies is the open policy question; here no exercise mediator is involved, so refusal stands.
summary: 该系列为C2C12肌管中Arrdc2/GFP腺病毒过表达，没有运动组，拒绝运行的理由成立。次要理由（矩阵列名与GSM标题无法按名称对应）已作为差异记录，不影响结论。
